events.evidence: Ukraine says that its forces have engaged North Korean troops for the first time in Kursk Oblast, Russia
At least twelve Palestinians are killed in Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip, including seven at the Kamal Adwan Hospital in Beit Lahia, North Gaza Governorate

label.note: First reported Ukraine-North Korea combat and Gaza/Lebanon strikes sustain geopolitical risk; Russia-Indonesia drill adds tension.
